commands.tail: Viche: records carry no committed merge-conflict markers

commands.command: /bin/sh scratch fixture: disposition-only mailbox -> sh government/branch-health.sh
commands.output: rc=0, no incident.json, observations signal 'clear', mailbox file hashes unchanged

commands.command: /bin/sh scratch fixture: addendum-only mailbox -> sh government/branch-health.sh
commands.output: rc=0, no incident.json, mailbox file hashes unchanged

commands.command: /bin/sh scratch fixture: disposition + undisposed *-report-* -> sh government/branch-health.sh
commands.output: rc=1, incident.json signals='judiciary_mailbox_pending', mailbox hashes unchanged, file count 2/2

commands.command: /bin/sh scratch fixture: undisposed file named *-addendum-request-* -> sh government/branch-health.sh
commands.output: rc=0, no incident.json — the filename predicate treats it as an answer; recorded as a limitation

commands.command: scratch fixture: list-shaped evidence beside an open case -> institutional-cases.py reconcile then report
commands.output: reconcile_rc=0, report_rc=0, fixture sha256 unchanged, owner refreshed legislature->judiciary, report excludes the fixture

commands.command: scratch fixture: only a list-shaped evidence file -> reconcile then report

content_assertions.actual: db42f8f's parent is e11d501 = origin/main at verification; e11d501..db42f8f is exactly one commit; the delta is four files (branch-health.sh, institutional-cases.py, tests/branch-health-smoke.sh, tests/institutional-recovery-smoke.sh); there is no records/suite-status.json carrier.
content_assertions.basis: git log -1 --format='%H %T %P'; git rev-parse origin/main; git rev-list --count e11d501..db42f8f; git diff --name-only
content_assertions.expected: Act 26 s2.1(7) and Act 28 s3(2): one commit whose parent is the then-current main, no intervening commits, no carrier.

content_assertions.actual: Two independent scratch fixtures: only 20261109T000000Z-judiciary-disposition-test.md -> rc 0, no incident.json, observation 'clear'; only 20261109T000002Z-addendum-review.md -> rc 0, no incident. Mailbox file hashes unchanged in both.
content_assertions.basis: scratch VICHE_STATE_ROOT fixtures; sh government/branch-health.sh; sha256 of all inbox .md files before/after
content_assertions.expected: A mailbox containing only the reviewer's own disposition or addendum does not hold judiciary_mailbox_pending (Executive claim i).

content_assertions.actual: With a disposition file present, adding 20261109T000001Z-report-test.md gives rc 1 and incident.json signals 'judiciary_mailbox_pending'; mailbox hashes and file count unchanged (2/2). Scope: the predicate is a filename substring match, so this holds for conventionally named reports; see the next assertion for the boundary.
content_assertions.basis: scratch fixture; branch-health.sh exit and incident.json; sha256 before/after
content_assertions.expected: An undisposed report still holds judiciary_mailbox_pending (Executive claim ii).

content_assertions.actual: Found and disclosed: an undisposed file whose NAME contains 'addendum' or 'disposition' is treated as an answer. Demonstrated with 20261109T000010Z-addendum-request.md: rc 0, no incident — an unreviewed impediment suppressed by name. The code comment states the convention is a deterministic filename heuristic; there is no metadata sidecar. This is a residual risk, not a failure of the intended convention; a negative test and a documented naming rule are still owed.
content_assertions.basis: scratch fixture above; government/branch-health.sh lines 87-103 at db42f8f
content_assertions.expected: The record must disclose any false-negative path in the signal predicate rather than certify claim ii beyond its scope.

content_assertions.actual: With an open case plus addendum-fixture.json containing a JSON list: reconcile rc 0, report rc 0, fixture sha256 unchanged, report output contains only the case object and excludes the fixture. With only the list file: reconcile rc 0, report rc 0, open_cases []. Both consumers now filter with isinstance(dict) and get('id').
content_assertions.basis: scratch VICHE_STATE_ROOT; python3 government/institutional-cases.py reconcile|report; sha256sum
content_assertions.expected: A list-shaped evidence file beside case objects no longer aborts reconcile or report, and is preserved (Executive claim iii).

content_assertions.actual: In every fixture the sha256 of all inbox .md files and the file count were identical before and after branch-health runs. Code inspection: the diff adds only reads of mailbox names; branch-health writes exclusively to branch state (observations.tsv, incident.json, history.jsonl) and the mailbox is never opened for write, renamed or deleted.
content_assertions.basis: sha256 of inbox before/after in scenarios 2-4; git diff e11d501 db42f8f -- government/branch-health.sh; grep for rm/mv/truncate in the mailbox section
content_assertions.expected: No mailbox file is removed or rewritten (Executive claim iv).

content_assertions.actual: The candidate also refreshes an existing case's owner on reconcile (an extra change not listed in the four claims). Tested: a case recorded with owner legislature becomes owner judiciary after reconcile for judiciary_mailbox_pending, state stays open; the new smoke fixture covers it.
content_assertions.basis: git diff of institutional-cases.py; scratch reconcile fixture
content_assertions.expected: Any change beyond the four claims is identified and tested rather than passed silently.

content_assertions.actual: No branch edit, no commit, no merge or fast-forward, nothing pushed. Only this state record, the detached digest, and the board pin were written.
content_assertions.basis: reviewer actions; origin/main unchanged at e11d501 at verification
content_assertions.expected: The reviewer must not edit the candidate or land anything.

independence_basis: Audit member c1a0000b. The candidate was proposed by the Executive Innovation Office and the review was requested by the Clerk (c1a00001); I am neither the proponent nor the Clerk. phase: Act 26 s2.1 pre-landing check of the squashed mailbox-signal repair (candidate db42f8f, one commit, direct child of base e11d501, no carrier).
